title: Flame Retardancy of Cellulose Fabrics Treated with 3-(Hydroxyphenyl Phosphinyl) Propanoic Acid
authors: Lianping Zhang; Sam Soo Kim; Jaewoong Lee
journal: Journal of the Korean Society of Dyers and Finishers / Textile Coloration and Finishing 20(5), 1–6
source_version: Published original PDF from journal KCI archive
sample_state: Untreated bleached cotton fabric control (KS K 0905); no HPPA, GPE, dyeing or durability wash assigned
composition: Bleached cotton fabric designated KS K 0905, purchased from Korea Apparel Testing & Research Institute; weave, areal density and yarn count are unreported
treatment_method: Use the bleached cotton fabric identified in Section 2.1 as the untreated control. No study-specific chemical finish, curing, dyeing, post-finish rinse or further washing is assigned to this control.
washing_state: Untreated control; prior bleaching reported, no durability wash assigned
TGA_instrument: TGA-50 thermal analyzer (DuPont, U.S.A.), as reported
TGA_specimen_preparation: Section 2.4 reports TGA under nitrogen at 10 °C/min. Section 3.3 and Figure 9 identify the cotton fabric states. Aliquot cutting or grinding, mass, pan, gas flow, conditioning, scan endpoints and replicate count are not stated.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Section 3.3: TGA curves of the cotton fabrics; Figure 9(a): untreated cotton
LOI_method: GB/T 5454-1997; YG-813 oxygen index tester (Changzhou No. 2 Textile Machinery Co., Ltd.); minimum oxygen and nitrogen concentrations required to pass the minimum burning length criterion
LOI_specimen_preparation: The source reports LOI measurements of the fabrics. Specimen dimensions, mounting, conditioning, number of replicates and statistical uncertainty are not given.
source_TG_definition_raw: The untreated cotton fabric has a decomposition temperature starting at 340 °C.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Table 1 gives untreated cotton LOI 18.4; Section 3.3 gives the untreated fabric decomposition starting temperature 340 °C in explicit prose. Both checked against original PDF pixels.
TG_locator: Section 3.3, p 5, first paragraph; Figure 9(a) identifies untreated cotton
source_location: Original six-page article, pp 1–6; material p 2; measured LOI method pp 2–3; nitrogen and 10 °C/min p 3; Table 1 p 4; decomposition starting temperature and Figure 9 p 5. Local original PDF and page images preserved.
pairing_evidence: The Table 1 untreated cotton fabric control with LOI 18.4 is the same untreated bleached cotton fabric identified in Section 2.1 and the untreated cotton fabric in Section 3.3 / Figure 9(a), whose decomposition is explicitly said to start at 340 °C. No treated or dyed condition is transferred.
limitations: One independently reviewed untreated cotton state. Tonset records the source-defined decomposition starting temperature; the operational tangent or mass-loss criterion is not reported, so it is not assigned to T5 or Tmax. Figure 9 has no printed quantitative TG labels; no curve coordinates or residue are extracted. The statement that few residue/char remains at 500 °C is qualitative and is not zero. The graph range is not used as a canonical scan endpoint. All five treated LOI states are held because no exact state-specific TG value is reported; HPPA-only curves also lack a curing-temperature assignment. Treatment bath concentrations, pickup and final drying after rinse are not given and are not invented. The four HPPA curing states have LOI 19.1, 19.6, 22.3 and 22.0, while HPPA plus GPE has LOI 26.4; these are not paired to the untreated TG. The reactive-dye experiment is separate from the proposed untreated control. The displayed LOI gas-ratio equation is incompletely parenthesized and omits a printed factor of 100; the tabulated measured LOI is used without recalculation. TGA-50 manufacturer is preserved exactly as reported. Four optical K/S readings are not LOI replication. DOI is confirmed by Crossref title, authors and pages; the old journal PDF itself does not print a DOI.
